subject: Operational MAP & evaluation blueprint: phased escort plan for SparkWell post-signature
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma.li@sparkwell.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps after signature — MAP materials

Hi Ben / Monica,

Thanks again — we signed yesterday and the team is excited to get moving. Attached is the preliminary roadmap our PM team wants to align with Redwood's MAP: four waves (pilot, canary, phased migration, org-wide training). High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm the canary window length we typically recommend for customer workloads (we have 2M monthly tokens baseline).
- A short evaluation plan that ties quality gates to rollback criteria (precision/latency thresholds).
- A draft week-by-week cadence for the first 8 weeks with named owners for each checkpoint.

Can you propose a compact onboarding workshop that covers the runtime, KV caching, and a hands-on canary run? Prefer week of 6/18 if possible.

Best,
Emma
Product Lead, SparkWell Health

Attachments: SparkWell_REQ_v0.9.xlsx

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@sparkwell.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps after signature — MAP materials

Emma — great to see SparkWell in the pipeline. Quick responses below and a proposed schedule attached.

- Canary window: for an initial traffic-shift we recommend a minimum 72-hour rolling window at 5–10% traffic, then expand to 48h at 25% if no regressions. For 2M tokens/month this should surface model variance and infra edge cases.
- Evaluation plan: we propose an "Operational MAP" worksheet (attached) that includes pass/fail gates: latency p95 < 450ms on dedicated, production-quality BLEU/ROUGE checks for generation tasks where applicable, and synthetic workload spike tests.
- Workshop: 2-hour hands-on (intro + canary run) followed by 1-hour follow-up after initial canary. Week of 6/18 works — recommend Wed 6/20 10:00 PT.

I've attached: 1) SparkWell_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP + week-by-week responsibilities) and 2) Canary_Test_Checklist.pdf. Monica, Marissa — can you confirm resource owners for training and SRE capture?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Director, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0191

Attachments: SparkWell_MAP_v1.2.xlsx; Canary_Test_Checklist.pdf

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma.li@sparkwell.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational MAP & evaluation blueprint: phased escort plan for SparkWell post-signature

Emma — adding SRE/training owners and clarifying a few checkpoints inline: 

- Week 0 (pre-cutover): account provisioning, API keys, network allowlist, baseline perf smoke test — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Infra).
- Week 1 (pilot): internal pilot with 2 dev users, verification that prefix caching reduces token cost on dev traces — Owner: Monica Patel (CS).
- Week 2–3 (canary): 72h @ 5–10% traffic -> expand to 48h @ 25% if OK. Canary tests include synthetic spike and cold-start trace. Rollback trigger: sustained latency spike >25% vs baseline or >1.5% degradation in quality on golden prompts.
- Week 4–6 (migration): staged tenant migration with manual gate every 24h. Provide runbook for fallback to hosted model variant.
- Week 7–8 (training): two 90-minute sessions: ops + developer quickstart. Owner: Marissa Cole (DX).

I've attached a CSV with recommended training participants and suggested lab exercises (training-sprint-roles.csv). Ben — can you share the DocuSign execution link and HubSpot record for the team? Emma — does your procurement/legal need any deviation from our standard data retention SLOs?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Li <emma.li@sparkwell.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rahul Desai <rahul.desai@sparkwell.com>, onboarding@sparkwell.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational MAP & evaluation blueprint: phased escort plan for SparkWell post-signature

Thanks — this looks solid. A couple of clarifications: 

1) Canary length: we can commit to the 72h @ 5–10% then expand. We just need the specific synthetic workloads from your side so our QA can run parallel verification.
2) Rollback criteria: the quality gate threshold sounds right; can you add a simple sampling protocol (n=200 prompts across 5 templates) for human review during the 25% expansion?
3) Procurement: no deviations on the retention SLOs; legal only asked for the standard SOC 2 annex which we already exchanged at signature.

Confirming the workshop on Wed 6/20 10:00 PT — Emma, Rahul, and our SRE lead will attend. Please send calendar invite and Zoom link.

Best,
Emma
